gate_rule.name: range-oi-flow-confirmation-v1
gate_rule.decision_time: unchanged source opened_ms; feature received_ms and exchange time must not exceed this as-of time
gate_rule.oi: latest valid sample received by decision and latest received by decision-5min; each endpoint at most90s old; strict decline
gate_rule.flow: last completed UTC minute; LONG buy_quote>sell_quote; SHORT sell_quote>buy_quote; equality rejects
gate_rule.flow_quality: one same-session target segment, full contiguous ID span/messages, adjacent previous-last and successor-first IDs; all used observations received by decision
gate_rule.connection_quality: same session starts before flow minute, covers minute and known successor; no recorded lifecycle, ID-gap or invalid-stream issue in five-minute context plus endpoint age allowance
gate_rule.unknown: missing, malformed, stale, late-mutated or uncertified evidence is UNKNOWN, never a rejection or zero return
gate_rule.costs: unchanged source entries, exits, quantity, risk and modeled costs; no replacement trades
gate_rule.scope: as-of paired observational label; delayed source publication is not proof of executable timing
gate_rule.future_safety: future rows cannot add feature information; a final target aggregate containing post-decision receipts is UNKNOWN because its past prefix cannot be reconstructed
gate_rule.market_scope: observed Binance aggTrade stream only, not all exchange transactions or complete liquidation volumes

selection: All exported RANGE_REBOUND_V3 source entries, no symbol/direction/outcome selection
threshold_search: NONE; no threshold or strategy changes after this diagnosis
unknown_accounting: UNKNOWN remains separate; no zero outcome or avoided loss credit
future_entries: None; source plans/outcomes are historical descriptive evidence only
